fullContent:
Karutha Gutika (Vati) 
 Reference – Sahasrayogam 
 Introduction 
 Karutha Gutika (Vati) is a powerful Ayurvedic formulation renowned for its blend of potent herbs. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Kankushta – Mallotus philippensis 
 Shallaki – Boswellia serrata 
 Hing – Ferula foetida 
 Ghritkumari – Aloe vera 
 Juice of Aloe vera 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Powder all the ingredients and mix with aloe vera juice. Make the pills of the paste. 
 Dose 
 Take the tablet and mix with cow milk, butter milk or castor oil and rub it over the forehead. 
 Indications 
 
 Headache 
 Common cold 
 Pediatric problems 
 
 Contraindications 
 Take under medical prescription. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
